recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Pharmacy reopens the broader dosage model; otherwise handle any small dosage-example editorial cleanup under separate issues.
issue_request: FHIR-5522 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy request to add rationale for when multiple Dosage Instruction elements would be used and to ensure examples show multiple elements for MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, and MedicationPrescription.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-5522 source commit or prior combined-branch audit was found. The current build has evolved from MedicationPrescription/MedicationOrder to MedicationRequest and from repeated Dosage instructions to one DosageDetails-valued dosageInstruction, with dosage narrative and examples covering complex regimes.
additional_context: MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, MedicationStatement, and MedicationAdministration are active current resources; DosageDetails is active and normative. Later Pharmacy work, including FHIR-25051, FHIR-54014, and the already-published FHIR-7737 reconciliation, explains the current renderedInstruction/DosageDetails model and related tapering/titration guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current source already provides rationale and examples, and adding language about repeated dosageInstruction elements would be obsolete for R6.

related_jiras.note: Clarified MedicationRequest dose/rate change and titration guidance and is already represented on the combined branch.
Applied R6 issue requiring DosageDetails.renderedInstruction, confirming the current model relies on one full rendered instruction plus structured details.
Published issue adding overall dosage instruction text, a predecessor to the current renderedInstruction pattern.
